claim.statement: Google's current Jules documentation says Jules can access only repositories explicitly allowed through GitHub, and a user selects an authorized repository and branch when starting a task.

source.title: Managing Jules tasks and repositories
source.locator: Managing repositories; Selecting a repo; Granting access to more repos

limitations: The source describes repository selection and access configuration, not the exact token scopes or every GitHub permission granted.
No repository authorization or branch selection was inspected.
unknowns: The effective GitHub App installation permissions, token scopes, organization policies and branch protections are unknown.
The repository and branch visible to a particular task are unknown.
